en: Disengaging warp drive.\nWe will soon be entering\ntarget planet's orbit.

I am unable to detect any
city-like structures. It
would appear the
civilization here is still
quite primitive.
No. I am not picking up on\nany mining sites.

Finally a planet that has
yet to be ravaged by the
rebels. I declare this place
Pasithee, after the
goddess of tranquility
herself.
Did you hear me, Coro? I\nsaid this place's name is\nPasithee.
A moment, if you would...
Don't tell me you've\nalready registered it as\nsomething else!?
No, it is not that... We\nseem to be receiving\ncommunications...
...Communications from\nplanet Pasithee.

You just told us that
civilization here is still in
its early stages. How do
they have the means to
do such a thing?

How, indeed... Heavens
above―I just realized
something. *Gulp* Maybe
they are gh-ghosts...
Ghosts!? That's the\nconclusion you come to?

My risk-assessment
evaluations indicate that
any interaction with
whoever―or whatever―is
trying to contact us could
be dangerous. We best
ignore them.
V-Very well, Captain. If you\nso wish, I shall open up a\nline of communication.
............subverted......are...the\ntower......to......stop......
Aaah! Gh-ghosts!!!

D-do you feel that!? A chill
permeates the air... And I
assure you it has nothing
to do with the ice cream I
took out of the fridge!

Speaking of which―oh, no!
It has melted all over the
Captain's chair... This is no
doubt the work of the
ghosts! They cursed―
Calm yourself!
A-a-and how exactly do\nyou suggest I do that!?

There is nothing to fear.
They are most likely
friendly spirits. They are,
after all, even making an
effort to speak in our
language.
Trust me. As the resident\nafterlife expert, I know\nwhat I am talking about.
Afterlife expert!? I was\nnot even aware such a\nthing existed...

That is beside the point.
What I am trying to say is
they pose no threat to us.
Now, come on! Take us
down.
I would strongly prefer not\nto...

So you intend to remain
up here alone? You do
realize that would increase
your chances of being
cursed by about 89%,
don't you?

Bah! C-commencing
landing sequence! Please
do not leave me all by
myself!

Excellent. Captain, I hope
you ready to learn the
identities of our
mysterious friends.
I have bad news.
As per usual. You never\ndo have anything good to\nsay.
How rude! That is not\ntrue!

I believe that at least 1
out of 10 times I deliver
good news. ...Or perhaps it
is slightly closer to 1 in
50? According to my
data―

I do not care for numbers.
Your desperation to prove
me wrong is so pitiful I am
close to tears.

Regardless, this is
unfortunately one of the
90% of times that I come
bearing bad news. Our
sensors are not
responding.

...Then that must mean
jamming waves are
present. I thought the
rebels did not make it to
this planet.
I saw no evidence of\nexcavations from orbit.

It is just as you say.
Tracking down the
individual responsible shall
be no easy feat.

Good news is, if that is
the case, you will not have
to come face-to-face with
the ghosts!
See, I do not always have\nbad things to say.

You really must quit with
the ghosts. There might
be actual people in
trouble!

Perhaps... Before landing, I
attempted to triangulate
the coordinates from
which the transmission
was coming.
We should be relatively\nclose to the location.
Let's search for our\nelusive friends!
We must shut down the\njamming waves.
I-I ain't afraid of no\nghosts!

Ever eager to lend a hand
to those in need―I
expected nothing less
from you, Captain!

Indeed. As you say, there
is every chance they
could be suffering from
starvation.
You best take some\nbananas with you!

While bananas are
nutritious, they do not
seem like the ideal food to
give to those in need...

A most logical approach!
We must secure our local
environment before
attempting anything else.

'Tis true that without our
sensors, finding those
behind the mysterious
communication would be
that much more difficult.
Let us hurry and restore\nthem to full operation.

I am glad to see that you,
too, have the sense to
fear that which is
unnatural!
*Sigh* The two of you\nneed to stop with this\nnonsense!
Now then, we best start\nscouting the nearby areas\nfor the tower.

I shall once again entrust
you, Eve, with a
counter-jamming device.
Please see that it is set
up properly.
Welcome back. Did your\nsearch yield anything of\ninterest?
What do you mean\nsomething about this\nplanet is not right...?

It is completely
uninhabited, and yet there
are a plethora of
man-made buildings.

In addition to that, the
forests here appear to be
synthetic. The trees on
this side grow thick but
over yonder they are thin
and sparse.
The very land itself also\nappears as though it has\nbeen cobbled together.
So you mean to say we\nare on an artificial planet...

It would not be completely
implausible, considering
the rebels did mention the
presence of towers can
influence the lay of the
land.

Indeed. It is just as you
say. We do not have
enough information to
form any concrete
conclusions.

Let us conduct a few
investigations so that we
can gain some more
insight into the matter.
Hoho! At long last, I have\ncaught my big break!
Big break? What are you\non about now?
I have good news!

In fact, I would go so far
as to say it is better than
good! The two of you will
be overcome with such
excitement it may well
stop your hearts!

If I did not know any
better, I'd say that
wanders dangerously
close to bad news. What
is it?
It is about the tower.
I managed to locate it.
We only just arrived! To\nthink that you were able\nto find it so quickly...
I told you I had good news!
Ever the voice of reason,\nCaptain. It is indeed far\ntoo early to get excited.
Now you best be off! It is\ntime to shut this tower\ndown!

Captain! Are you all
right!? To think that
Thornites would be
present on this planet...
We should have been
more careful.

If HE was here, would you
say there is a possibility
that Thornites are, in fact,
weapons created by
Levarance?
It is not out of the\nquestion.

If anyone were to create
sentient weapons that
cannot be analyzed by
federation scanners...
...It would be Levarance.\nTheir technology is\nnothing to sneeze at.
Thankfully, the Captain's\nskills are also nothing to\nsneeze at.

The sensors should now
be back online. Do you
think you can track down
the individuals that
attempted to contact us?

Yes. I have confirmed the
tower is down. I shall
begin searching for our
friends.
Just a moment... Well,\nthat is odd...
What's wrong?
The sensors are still\ndown.
What do you mean? Is the\ntower still somehow\nfunctioning?
No. I have confirmed that\nit has been shut down.

I will look into what could
be causing this. In the
meantime, I would ask the
two of you come back to
the ship.
So it's not broken?
No it is not, but I have no\nidea what is wrong.\nPerhaps the ghosts―

If you're so fond of
ghosts, maybe I should
incorporate a summoning
chant into your boot-up
sequence.
No, please! Anything but\nthat!

We're receiving another
communication! I-it is them
again! We must avoid
interaction at all costs!
...As you wish, Captain. I\nshall open up a line of\ncommunication.
...subverted...
It's the exact same\nmessage as last time!
............subverted......the\nthree towers...to......stop...

Aaah! Gh-ghosts! Eve,
could you incorporate a
chant to keep them away
into my boot-up
sequence?

Now is not the time for
your nonsense! Did you
listen to the message at
all!?
Of course not! I do not\nwant to be cursed!
If anything, the message\nwas a blessing more than\nanything.

They mentioned there are
three towers! That means
there are two more on
this planet emitting
jamming signals!
It would explain why the\nsensors haven't\nrecovered.
To think we have solved\nbut one-third of the\nproblem...

As you say, Captain.
Moping will get us
nowhere. We must press
forward.

I shall begin searching for
the locations of the other
towers. I will let you know
as soon as I find them.
Captain! I have located\nthe whereabouts of the\nsecond tower.

You know, every other
planet we have been on
has only had a single
tower. Why is it that this
one has three?

An excellent question.
Perhaps learning the
answer to that would even
provide us with a greater
understanding of the evil
we face.
It is all very curious...

Yes, Captain! You are
absolutely right―now is
the time for action, not
speculation!
I really need to learn to\nfocus better...

Well, what are the two of
you waiting for? There is
a tower that needs
decommissioning!
You did it! The tower is\ndead!
Truly, your skills know no\nbounds.

*Sigh* I was truly naive in
thinking that this place
would simply be a pit
stop.
Look at this, you two. I\nfound something―a rather\ncurious slip of parchment.

Why would that be in the
recesses of such a
technologically advanced
tower!? It does not make
any sense to me.
It appears to be a map of\nthe interior.
A secret map!? Perhaps\nthat also means there is a\nhidden treasure nearby!

Terrified of ghosts and
easily excited by
treasure... If I didn't know
better, I would guess you
were programmed by a 10
year old boy.

I would like to analyze
your findings so please be
sure to bring the map
back with you.
I have finished my\nanalysis!

According to my data, it
should be here. This is no
doubt where the hidden
treasure lies!

I wouldn't be so sure
about that. We are more
likely to dig up a grave full
of ghosts rather than
riches!
P-please, no! Anything but\nthat!

All joking aside, do you
think this is where the
third tower is located? I
wonder if it will yield any
clues about the
mysterious call we
received...

Unfortunately, this map is
not enough to determine
the answer to that. You
would have to go and
investigate the area.

I have stored all
information regarding the
location. Let the search
begin!

I pray for your sakes that
there are no ghosts
waiting for you upon your
arrival.
You are very close to the\nlocation indicated on the\nmap.
That is no tower. In fact, it\nappears to be a hideout\nof some kind...

Perhaps this facility is
somehow related to the
mysterious
communications we've
been receiving!
...You mean the gh―
N-never mind! Pretend I\nsaid nothing...
Well, let's go and take a\nlook inside, shall we?
I'm sure our search of the\nplace will yield a lot more\nthan just ghosts.
...Why must you keep\nbringing them up?
You make mention of them\nfar more than I do!

Now, if you do not forever
want to be labeled a
coward, I suggest you do
everything in your power
to help us with this
mission!

I am so glad the two of
you are alive! I was so
overwhelmed with worry it
nearly corrupted my hard
drive!

Oh, please do not
misunderstand! It is not
that I do not have faith in
your abilities. I just
thought the gh―
er...unfamiliar terrains got
the best of you.
So, what did you learn\nabout the facility?

It is not so much a facility
as a residential building of
some kind... Regardless of
the exact nature of the
structure, it has long
since been abandoned.
Did you uncover any\nclues?

We found just one thing:
someone left a voice
recording in the radio
room.

I must advise against it,
Captain. Whatever is on
that tape could very well
curse us!

<font color=yellow>Operation: Frost</font> must be
subverted at all costs.
<font color=yellow>Pulse towers</font> are the
devil's tool, used to
spread death and
destruction across the
galaxy.

Even now the three
towers threaten to
swallow our planet whole...
Please, whoever you are,
we beg of you, find a way
to stop them!
This...
It's the communication\nwe've been receiving!

...So no one was actually
trying to contact us. We
were simply picking up on
a voice recording on loop.

I guess they left it playing
in the extremely unlikely
event that someone would
eventually hear it.
What happened to the\npeople that originally\ninhabited this planet?

And these pulse towers
they make mention
of―they are the towers
emitting jamming waves,
right?

Additionally, what exactly
is this Operation: Frost to
which they refer? Is it
somehow related to
Levarance?
I cannot say. I only know\nas much as you do.
And so the plot thickens...

Those things aren't
important right now. We
need to shut down the
third tower.
More questions means\nwe've gained more\ninformation.
I'm just glad it was a voice\nrecording and not ghosts!
Indeed. We must first\nfocus on the task at hand.

Besides, taking out the
final tower will have the
added benefit of delivering
a blow to the Purge.
That is right, true, correct!\nI did not think of it in that\nway.

The more of the Purge's
schemes we foil, the more
we will be able to learn
about them.
Indeed! Stored data is\nnothing to be afraid of!
The two of you are more\nsimilar than I thought...

*Sigh* I am simply glad
that the communication
signal was nothing more
than exactly that.

Now then, it is high time
we honored their wishes
and shut down the final
pulse tower!
There it is―the third pulse\ntower.
That took far longer than\nit should have.
*Sigh* At least this is the\nlast one.
I wonder why the\nindividuals in the recording\nfailed to shut it down...
All it entails is removing\nthe energy unit.
So it is as you\nsuspected...
What did I suspect?

The reason they were
unable to perform such a
simple task is because
their ethereal hands
passed right through the
unit...
Aaaaaah!
Leave me be! Please, do\nnot let them come near\nme!
Compose yourself! I was\nsimply teasing.
...Teasing?
I know for a fact that they\nwere not ghosts.
The aftermath of a vicious\nbattle was present in the\ntower.

It was likely the result of
an attempt by our friends
to breach the building's
security.

That is such a relief to
hear. You very nearly cut
my lifespan in half with
your earlier remarks!
If there are no ghosts,\nthen I do not see any\nproblems.
Let us press forward and\ndeliver this planet from\nevil!
The third tower is gone.\nExcellent work.
Yes, the sensors have\nindeed come back online.\nPlanet Pasithee is saved!

It feels as though a cloud
has lifted and the grief of
those in the recordings
has dissipated.

It is all thanks to the
captain. None of this
would have been possible
without you.

Finding your way back to
the ship is going to be the
true test of your skills.
Stay safe.
We are now back in orbit.
An artificial planet with\nthree pulse towers and\nThornites...
...In addition to a strange\ndistress call...

The mysteries of this
place run far and deep. I
hope one day we will learn
the truth behind it all...

Indeed, I am especially
curious about the
Operation: Frost that was
mentioned in the
recording.
I nearly forgot about that.\nI, too, wonder what that\ncould be...

It is no doubt as you say,
Captain. Everything that
happened here is
somehow related to the
Purge's nefarious plans.

Yes, but so long as we
continue our pursuit of
them, we will eventually
learn how everything is
connected.

I could not agree
more―especially if we
were somehow able to
apprehend the guerrilla
leader!
Indeed. We must go on the\noffensive!

I shall begin calculating
the coordinates for the
next star system. It will
take but a moment.
Done. Whenever you are\nready to leave, just let me\nknow.
Then, let's be off. We\nhaven't a moment to lose!

You have discovered a
New Route. You can now
choose this New Route
from the Select Planet
screen.
